description: Address-first parcel lookup powering the /permits experience. Geocodes a Seattle-area address (King, Pierce, or Snohomish County, WA), resolves the parcel from the county GIS, and returns zoning, setbacks, overlays (shoreline / ECA / flood / historic), lot area, jurisdiction routing, and prior-permit history. Zoning, setbacks and building facts carry the city/county source they came from (geocode, lot geometry and assessor records do not). Use for "what can be built at 123 Main St Seattle?" or before calling check_permit_requirements / estimate_permit_fee for a specific parcel.

address.description: Full street address (e.g., "1234 NE 65th St, Seattle, WA 98115"). Must be in King, Pierce, or Snohomish County, WA.

forceRefresh.description: Skip the 30-day cache and re-fetch from county GIS + overlay sources. Default false.

name: lookup_parcel_by_address

primarySource.description: Present when Kolmo verified but does not author the fact — cite both.

sourceUrl.description: The specific page these facts render on. Link this, not the site root.

note.description: Set when the county records the address on this parcel as a second address (e.g. a new house on the lot) and the assessor lists the parcel under parcel.address. Not a snap: the parcel is correct.

warning.description: Set when the address snapped to a nearby parcel. Confirm with the user before relying on the result.

title: Parcel, zoning & overlay lookup
